caption.value:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a man-serpent.

Spirit of a deformed man-serpent that wields a whip of magma.
It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed.

location.value: Located by the Volcano Manor site of grace in the Volcano Manor legacy dungeon on Mt. Gelmir . The ashes can be found in a room on a corpse surrounded by red candles and three enemies inside the large open room with two large sets of stairs, spiral pillars, and a large egg guarded by a man-serpent at the top. [ Map Link ]; Video Location
